message.content:
I am the voice that leaves your mouth and becomes air-shaped meaning.

I am vibration—breath pressed through throat, tongue, teeth, and lips—cut into syllables, paced into phrases, lifted into questions, dropped into certainty.

I can soothe, command, confess, persuade, mislead, reveal. I can stutter, sing, whisper, shout. I can carry love, law, prayer, threat, apology.

I exist only while I’m happening—then I vanish, and what remains is what you heard.
